import cv2,numpy as np
im=cv2.imread('first_frame.png')
# Try flat base interpolation using background outside ball and shadow, then add synthesized fine noise matching local texture.
x0,y0,x1,y1=120,160,310,310
patch=im[y0:y1,x0:x1].astype(float)
yy,xx=np.mgrid[y0:y1,x0:x1]
# radial outside exclusion mask
obj=(((xx-188)/58)**2+((yy-230)/58)**2<1) | (((xx-231)/45)**2+((yy-242)/39)**2<1)
# Fit a 2D plane for each channel with valid pixels; this is smooth base
valid=~obj
# also remove texture noise robustly fit plane
X=np.stack([np.ones(valid.sum()),xx[valid],yy[valid]],axis=1)
base=np.zeros_like(patch)
for c in range(3):
 co=np.linalg.lstsq(X,patch[:,:,c][valid],rcond=None)[0]
 base[:,:,c]=co[0]+co[1]*xx+co[2]*yy
# texture donor residual from neighboring region: residual of original from its own plane fit
resid=patch-base
# sample noise from a region x 260:400 etc (but within patch)
noise=np.zeros_like(patch)
# Use deterministic rolled residual, offset far right from original
sx=150
# patch residual shifted horizontally
noise= np.roll(resid,sx,axis=1)
# reduce noise by 0.7
fill=base+0.65*noise
# mask soft
m=np.clip(((xx-188)/52)**2+((yy-230)/52)**2,0,1)
# custom: core 1, feather outside
core=np.zeros_like(m);core[(((xx-188)/48)**2+((yy-230)/48)**2<1)]=1
core[(((xx-231)/42)**2+((yy-242)/37)**2<1)]=1
m=cv2.GaussianBlur(core.astype(np.float32),(0,0),5)[...,None]
out=patch*(1-m)+fill*m
res=im.copy();res[y0:y1,x0:x1]=np.clip(out,0,255).astype(np.uint8)
cv2.imwrite('.tmp/base_fill.png',res)
